_note: Approximate peak-to-trough moves of each currency against USD over the episode window. Negative = foreign currency weakened vs USD. Rounded for illustration.

scenarios.name: Global Financial Crisis
scenarios.description: Flight to the dollar and yen as global credit froze; commodity and EM currencies collapsed.

scenarios.name: Taper Tantrum
scenarios.description: Fed signals QE tapering; 'Fragile Five' currencies sell off as US yields jump.

scenarios.name: SNB Removes EUR/CHF Floor
scenarios.description: The Swiss National Bank abandons its 1.20 peg; the franc jumps ~20% in minutes.

scenarios.name: Brexit Referendum
scenarios.description: The UK votes to leave the EU; sterling falls to a 31-year low.

scenarios.name: EM & Trade-War Selloff
scenarios.description: Fed hikes plus US–China tariffs trigger broad EM weakness (lira, peso, real, rupee).

scenarios.name: COVID-19 Dash for Cash
scenarios.description: Global scramble for dollar liquidity; commodity and EM currencies plunge.

scenarios.name: King Dollar 2022
scenarios.description: Aggressive Fed hiking sends the dollar index to a 20-year high; yen and sterling slide.

scenarios.name: Dollar Slide 2025
scenarios.description: Tariff uncertainty and diversification away from USD assets weaken the dollar broadly.
